207:t_002:9.en:
$$赤城$$
「I wish you all the best in battle!」

207:t_002:10.en:
$$赤木$$
「Don't you worry, Miss $$スズネ$$, and you too, $$龍之介$$! We'll defend $$第２新東京市$$!」

207:t_002:11.en:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「Captain $$ジェフリー$$, what's the status of each of $c's ships?」

207:t_002:12.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「They have sortied, for the time being, and are standing by outside this area, but repairs are not yet fully complete, on the ships or on the units they carry.」

207:t_002:13.en:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「So we have no choice but to fight with the forces we have here right now...」

207:t_002:14.en:
$$ウラジミール$$
「Distortion of the dimensional boundary line confirmed.」

207:t_002:15.en:
$$田中司令$$
「A $$時空震動$$ at a time like this!?」

207:t_002:16.en:
$$ＷＩＬＬ$$
「It is not on that large a scale. But...」

207:t_028:1.en:
$$いぶき$$
「And on top of that, several of them have appeared!」

207:t_028:2.en:
$$青山$$
「Damn it! The worst possible coincidences have piled up!」

207:t_028:4.en:
$$赤木$$
「From this position, we're the only ones who can take on the $$ヘテロダイン$$! We've got no choice but to do it!」

207:t_028:5.en:
$n
「Miss $$スズネ$$! Have you made contact with $$宗介$$!?」

207:t_028:6.en:
$$スズネ$$
「It's no use...! There's been no response since a while ago!」

207:t_028:8.en:
$$甲児$$
「First we take care of the AS units and the $$ヘテロダイン$$! After that, we head for $$陣代高校$$!」

207:t_028:9.en:
$$アルト$$
「Hold on, $$宗介$$...! I'll be right there!」

207:t_003:1.en:
$$甲児$$
(If you're all right, hurry up and answer...)

207:t_029:0.en:
$$一成$$
「Damn it! What the hell is all this, anyway? It's been going on since a while ago!」

207:t_029:1.en:
$$大貫$$
「H-hurry up and get away from here, everyone!」

207:t_029:2.en:
$$林水$$
(It appears we were too late, $$相良$$...)

207:t_029:5.en:
$$一成$$
「Look! There's an AS at the school too!」

207:t_004:0.en:
$$クラマ$$
「A $$ミスリル$$ model with a $$ラムダ・ドライバ$$...! It was lying in wait under $$ＥＣＳ$$!」

207:t_004:1.en:
$$宗介$$
「You may know about the $$アーバレスト$$, but it seems your investigation of $$アル$$ was insufficient!」

207:t_004:2.en:
$$クラマ$$
「Tch...! So the operation is a failure!」

207:t_004:4.en:
$$宗介$$
「There's no need to pursue them, $$レイス$$. I leave $$常磐$$ to you.」

207:t_004:5.en:
$$レイス$$
「Understood. That we could not stop their advance this far is partly my responsibility, as the bodyguard of $$千鳥かなめ$$.」

207:t_004:6.en:
$$宗介$$
「I will crush them and protect $$千鳥$$...!」

207:t_004:8.en:
$$宗介$$
「I'm sorry I made you go through something so frightening, $$常磐$$.」

207:t_004:9.en:
$$宗介$$
「I am exactly the kind of person that man said I was. I can no longer stay at school.」

207:t_004:10.en:
$$宗介$$
「But $n and $$アルト$$ and the others are different... They are... different from me...」

207:t_004:13.en:
$$宗介$$
「They were happy days. Thank you.」

207:t_005:1.en:
$$アルト$$
「This guy... making us worry like that!」

207:t_005:3.en:
$$宗介$$
「She has fainted, but she's safe. She is being evacuated now.」

207:t_005:4.en:
$$宗介$$
「But I'm sorry... Because of me, you all can no longer go to $$陣代高校$$...」

207:t_005:5.en:
$n
「...Don't worry about it. Even if we can't attend $$陣代高校$$, we can still protect everyone at $$陣代高校$$.」

207:t_005:7.en:
$n
「$$陣代高校$$ is an important place to me. So if I can fight to protect it, I have no regrets at all.」

207:t_005:10.en:
$$宗介$$
「You did well too, Al. I am grateful to you.」

207:t_005:11.en:
$$アル$$
「Let us be sure to make it back alive.」

207:t_005:12.en:
$$宗介$$
「Why are you saying something so obvious now?」

207:t_005:15.en:
$$アル$$
「A premonition that I will be parting with you.」

207:t_005:18.en:
$$マオ$$
「One enemy is coming at you!」

207:t_006:1.en:
$$アル$$
「I believe it is a $$ラムダ・ドライバ$$-equipped model. Its other specs cannot be estimated.」

207:t_006:2.en:
???
「You really are a watchdog who won't give up, aren't you.」

207:t_006:4.en:
$$レナード$$
「Rest assured. I have no intention of taking the people left in the school building hostage.」

207:t_006:5.en:
$$レナード$$
「It's just that, if you still won't give up and hand her over, you know what comes next, don't you?」

207:t_006:6.en:
$$宗介$$
「He's going out of his way to use an external speaker to taunt us...」

207:t_006:7.en:
$$レナード$$
「No reply. So you intend to keep resisting to the end.」

207:t_006:8.en:
$$レナード$$
「That refusal to see reason... Do you perhaps think it makes you look cool?」

207:t_006:9.en:
$$レナード$$
「You know, I rather dislike that sort of thing... $$相良宗介$$.」

207:t_006:10.en:
$$風間$$
「The AS fighting that white one over there...」

207:t_006:11.en:
$$小野Ｄ$$
「No doubt about it! That pilot called out $$相良$$'s name!」

207:t_006:12.en:
$$風間$$
「Then the one riding the white AS is $$相良$$!?」

207:t_006:13.en:
$$宗介$$
「$$レナード・テスタロッサ$$...!」

207:t_006:14.en:
$$レナード$$
「Well then, shall we begin?」

207:t_007:1.en:
$$アル$$
「I surmise it is most likely an added capability from the $$ラムダ・ドライバ$$.」

207:t_007:3.en:
$$宗介$$
「This one has a $$ラムダ・ドライバ$$! $$アーバレスト$$ will take it on!」

207:t_007:4.en:
$$オズマ$$
「Much as it galls me, we have no force to spare to support $$宗介$$ either...」

龍之介.evidence: Shunsuke Akagi addresses Ryunosuke Akagi (glossary 赤城龍之介, male) by given name; no given-name-only token in the sheet

美樹原.evidence: Hayashimizu addresses Ren Mikihara (glossary 美樹原蓮 = Ren Mikihara, female) by surname; no surname-only token in the sheet

207:t_028:1: 'several of them' - Heterodyne kept as the implied subject
207:t_002:11: $c's ships - the Japanese has just $c各艦 (each ship of $c)

207:t_002:10 vs t_002:9: $$赤城$$ is Ryunosuke Akagi, $$赤木$$ is Shunsuke Akagi; both tokens read 'Akagi'
207:t_006:6: Sousuke says 'He's' of the enemy pilot before naming Leonard (t_006:13); Leonard is male per glossary and Sousuke already recognized the voice
207:t_006:11: Ono D: 'That pilot' used for the enemy to avoid assuming gender
